title: Update fd.c: remove asym from INIT, add do_sign/do_verify/do_agree/reset handlers
description: In src/cdev/crypto2dev_fd.c: remove OP_SIGN/OP_VERIFY/OP_AGREE validation from ioctl_init key-type checking; remove ioctl_set_sig and ioctl_get_sig handlers; add ioctl_do_sign (looks up key_fd internally, calls ops->sign); add ioctl_do_verify (looks up key_fd, calls ops->verify, maps -EBADMSG); add ioctl_do_agree (looks up key_fd, calls ops->agree); add ioctl_reset (checks finalized==true, calls ops->sess_reset, clears outbuf state); update dispatch switch to handle new ioctl numbers and drop slots 6/7.
